# Gorkhouse

> > A comprehensive home and property resource covering renovation, maintenance, smart home technology, and sustainable living solutions.

Gorkhouse provides practical guides and expert advice for homeowners, covering everything from HVAC systems and solar energy to orchid care and property management. The site features location-specific content for regions including Auckland, Ontario, Canberra, and Geelong, with emphasis on cost-effective improvements and eco-friendly solutions.
